flawed_step: 0040 | It remains to resolve the inequality for p, q \in \mathbb R_{\ge 0}.
assessment_summary: This reduction is unjustified. After handling the infinite exponents and identifying M_0, the proof has not handled finite negative-exponent cases, including p<q<0 and p<q=0. Thus it cannot restrict the remaining argument to nonnegative p and q.
